Elements P and Q have the same number of electron shells.
An atom of Q has more electrons in its outer electron shell than an atom of P.
Which statements are correct?
1
P and Q are in the same group of the Periodic Table.
2
P and Q are in the same period of the Periodic Table.
3
P has a greater tendency to form positive ions than Q.
4
The oxide of Q is more basic than the oxide of P.
A
1 and 3
B
1 and 4
C
2 and 3
D
2 and 4
